Alif Laam Raa. Yeh kitaab hai jise hum ne aap ki taraf naazil kiya hai taake aap logon ko hukm-e-Khuda se taareekiyon se nikaal kar noor ki taraf le aayein aur Khuda-e-Azeez o Hameed ke raaste par laga dein
Woh Allah woh hai jis ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki har shai hai, aur kaafiron ke liye to sakht-tareen aur afsos-naak azaab hai

Woh log jo zindagaani-e-duniya ko aakhirat ke muqaable mein pasand karte hain aur logon ko raah-e-Khuda se rokte hain aur us mein kaji paida karna chaahte hain, yeh gumraahi mein bahut door tak chale gaye hain

Aur hum ne jis rasool ko bhi bheja usi ki qaum ki zabaan ke saath bheja taake woh logon par baaton ko waazeh kar sake. Us ke baad Khuda jis ko chaahta hai gumraahi mein chhod deta hai aur jis ko chaahta hai hidaayat de deta hai, woh saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi

Aur hum ne Moosa ko apni nishaaniyon ke saath bheja ke apni qaum ko zulmaton se noor ki taraf nikaal kar laayein aur inhein Khudaai dinon ki yaad dilaayein, ke beshak is mein tamaam sabr karne waalon aur shukr karne waalon ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Moosa ne apni qaum se kaha ke tum log Allah ki us ne'mat ko yaad karo ke us ne tumhein Fir'aun waalon se najaat dilaayi, jab ke woh badtareen azaab mein mubtala kar rahe the, ke tumhaare ladkon ko zibah kar rahe the aur tumhaari ladkiyon ko (kaneezi ke liye) zinda rakhte the, aur is mein tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se bada sakht imtehaan tha
Aur jab tumhaare Parwardigar ne e'laan kiya ke agar tum hamaara shukriya ada karoge to hum ne'maton mein izaafa kar denge, aur agar kufraan-e-ne'mat karoge to hamaara azaab bhi bahut sakht hai
Aur Moosa ne yeh bhi keh diya ke agar tum sab aur roo-e-zameen ke tamaam basne waale bhi kaafir ho jaayein to hamaara Allah sab se be-niyaaz hai aur woh qaabil-e-hamd o sataaish hai

Kya tumhaare paas apne se pehle waalon, qaum-e-Nooh aur qaum-e-Aad o Samood aur jo un ke baad guzre hain aur jinhein Khuda ke ilaawa koi nahin jaanta hai, ki khabar nahin aayi hai? Ke un ke paas Allah ke rasool mo'jizaat le kar aaye aur unhon ne un ke haathon ko unhi ke munh ki taraf palta diya, aur saaf keh diya ke hum tumhaare laaye hue paighaam ke munkir hain, aur humein us baat ke baare mein waazeh shak hai jis ki taraf tum humein daawat de rahe ho

To rasoolon ne kaha ke kya tumhein Allah ke baare mein bhi shak hai jo zameen o aasmaan ka paida karne waala hai, aur tumhein is liye bulaata hai ke tumhaare gunaahon ko maaf kar de aur ek mu'ayyana muddat tak zameen mein chain se rehne de? To un logon ne jawaab diya ke tum sab bhi hamaare hi jaise bashar ho aur chaahte ho ke humein un cheezon se rok do jin ki hamaare baap daada ibaadat kiya karte the, to ab koi khuli hui daleel le aao

Un se rasoolon ne kaha ke yaqeenan hum tumhaare hi jaise bashar hain, lekin Khuda jis bande par chaahta hai makhsoos ehsaan bhi karta hai, aur hamaare ikhtiyaar mein yeh bhi nahin hai ke hum bila-izn-e-Khuda koi daleel ya mo'jiza le aayein, aur saahibaan-e-imaan to sirf Allah hi par bharosa karte hain

Aur hum kyon na Allah par bharosa karein jab ke usi ne humein hamaare raaston ki hidaayat di hai, aur hum yaqeenan tumhaari aziyyaton par sabr karenge, aur bharosa karne waale to Allah hi par bharosa karte hain

Aur kaafiron ne apne rasoolon se kaha ke hum tum ko apni sarzameen se nikaal baahar kar denge ya tum hamaare mazhab ki taraf palat aaoge. To Parwardigar ne un ki taraf wahi ki ke khabardaar ghabraao nahin, hum yaqeenan zaalimeen ko tabaah o barbaad kar denge
Aur tumhein un ke baad zameen mein aabaad kar denge, aur yeh sab un logon ke liye hai jo hamaare maqaam aur martabe se darte hain aur hamaare azaab ka khauf rakhte hain
Aur paighambaron ne hum se fatah ka mutaalaba kiya, aur un se inaad rakhne waale sarkash afraad zaleel aur ruswa ho gaye
Un ke peechhe Jahannam hai aur inhein peep-daar paani pilaaya jaaega
Jise ghoont ghoont piyenge aur woh inhein gawaara na hoga, aur inhein maut har taraf se gher legi haalaanke woh marne waale nahin hain, aur un ke peechhe bahut sakht azaab laga hua hai

Jin logon ne apne Parwardigar ka inkaar kiya un ke aamaal ki misaal us raakh ki hai jise andhad ke din ki tund hawa uda le jaaye, ke woh apne haasil kiye hue par bhi koi ikhtiyaar na rakhenge, aur yahi bahut door tak phaili hui gumraahi hai
Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne zameen aur aasmaanon ko barhaq paida kiya hai? Woh chaahe to tum ko fana kar ke ek nayi makhlooq ko la sakta hai
Aur Allah ke liye yeh baat koi mushkil nahin hai

Aur qiyaamat ke din sab Allah ke saamne haazir honge, to kamzor log mustakbireen se kahenge ke hum to aap ke pairokaar the, to kya aap azaab-e-Ilaahi ke muqaable mein hamaare kuch kaam aa sakte hain? To woh jawaab denge ke agar Khuda humein hidaayat de deta to hum bhi tumhein hidaayat de dete. Ab to hamaare liye sab hi baraabar hai chaahe faryaad karein ya sabr karein, ke ab koi chhutkaara milne waala nahin hai

Aur Shaitaan tamaam umoor ka faisla ho jaane ke baad kahega ke Allah ne tum se bilkul barhaq waada kiya tha aur main ne bhi ek waada kiya tha, phir main ne apne waade ki mukhaalifat ki, aur mera tumhaare oopar koi zor bhi nahin tha siwaaye is ke ke main ne tumhein daawat di aur tum ne use qubool kar liya. To ab tum meri malaamat na karo balke apne nafs ki malaamat karo, ke na main tumhaari faryaad-rasi kar sakta hoon na tum meri faryaad ko pahunch sakte ho. Main to pehle hi se is baat se bezaar hoon ke tum ne mujhe us ka shareek bana diya, aur beshak zaalimeen ke liye bahut bada dardnaak azaab hai
Aur saahibaan-e-imaan o amal-e-saaleh ko un jannaton mein daakhil kiya jaaega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, woh hamesha hukm-e-Khuda se wahin rahenge, aur un ki mulaaqaat ka tohfa salaam hoga
Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne kis tarah kalima-e-tayyiba ki misaal shajara-e-tayyiba se bayaan ki hai jis ki asl saabit hai aur us ki shaakh aasmaan tak pahunchi hui hai
Yeh shajara har zamaane mein hukm-e-Parwardigar se phal deta rehta hai, aur Khuda logon ke liye misaal bayaan karta hai ke shaayad isi tarah hosh mein aa jaayein
Aur kalima-e-khabeesa ki misaal us shajara-e-khabeesa ki hai jo zameen ke oopar hi se ukhaad kar phenk diya jaaye aur us ki koi buniyaad na ho
Allah saahibaan-e-imaan ko qaul-e-saabit ke zariye duniya aur aakhirat mein saabit-qadam rakhta hai, aur zaalimeen ko gumraahi mein chhod deta hai, aur woh jo bhi chaahta hai anjaam deta hai
Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha jinhon ne Allah ki ne'mat ko kufraan-e-ne'mat se tabdeel kar diya aur apni qaum ko halaakat ki manzil tak pahuncha diya
Woh Jahannam jis mein sab waasil honge, aur woh badtareen qaraar-gaah hai
Aur un logon ne Allah ke liye misl qaraar diye taake us ke zariye logon ko behka sakein. To aap keh dijiye ke thode din aur maze kar lo, phir to tumhaara anjaam Jahannam hi hai

Aur aap mere imaandaar bandon se keh dijiye ke namaazein qaaim karein aur hamaare rizq mein se khufiya aur e'laaniya hamaari raah mein infaaq karein, qabl is ke ke woh din aa jaaye jab na tijaarat kaam aaegi aur na dosti

Allah hi woh hai jis ne aasmaan o zameen ko paida kiya hai, aur aasmaan se paani barsa kar us ke zariye tumhaari rozi ke liye phal paida kiye hain, aur kashtiyon ko musakhkhar kar diya hai ke samandar mein us ke hukm se chalein, aur tumhaare liye nahron ko bhi musakhkhar kar diya hai
Aur tumhaare liye harkat karne waale aaftaab o maahtaab ko bhi musakhkhar kar diya hai, aur tumhaare liye raat aur din ko bhi musakhkhar kar diya hai

Aur jo kuch tum ne maanga us mein se kuch na kuch zaroor diya, aur agar tum us ki ne'maton ko shumaar karna chaahoge to hargiz shumaar nahin kar sakte. Beshak insaan bada zaalim aur inkaar karne waala hai
Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Ibraheem ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Is shehar ko mahfooz bana de aur mujhe aur meri aulaad ko but-parasti se bachaaye rakhna
Parwardigar! In buton ne bahut se logon ko gumraah kar diya hai, to ab jo mera ittibaa' karega woh mujh se hoga, aur jo ma'siyat karega us ke liye tu bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Parwardigar! Main ne apni zurriyat mein se ba'z ko tere mohtaram makaan ke qareeb be-aab o giyaah waadi mein chhod diya hai taake namaazein qaaim karein. Ab tu logon ke dilon ko un ki taraf mod de aur inhein phalon ka rizq ata farma taake woh tere shukr-guzaar bande ban jaayein
Parwardigar! Hum jis baat ka e'laan karte hain ya jis ko chhupaate hain tu sab se baakhabar hai, aur Allah par zameen o aasmaan mein koi cheez makhfi nahin reh sakti
Shukr hai us Khuda ka jis ne mujhe budhaape mein Ismaaeel o Is'haaq jaisi aulaad ata ki hai, ke beshak mera Parwardigar duaaon ka sunne waala hai
Parwardigar! Mujhe aur meri zurriyat mein namaaz qaaim karne waale qaraar de, aur Parwardigar! Meri dua ko qubool kar le
Parwardigar! Mujhe aur mere waalidain ko aur tamaam momineen ko us din bakhsh dena jis din hisaab qaaim hoga
Aur khabardaar Khuda ko zaalimeen ke aamaal se ghaafil na samajh lena, ke woh inhein us din ke liye mohlat de raha hai jis din aankhein khauf se pathra jaayengi
Sar uthaaye bhaage chale ja rahe honge aur palkein bhi na palatti hongi, aur un ke dil dehshat se hawa ho rahe honge

Aur aap logon ko us din se daraayein jis din un tak azaab aa jaaega, to zaalimeen kahenge ke Parwardigar! Humein thodi muddat ke liye palta de ke hum teri daawat ko qubool kar lein aur tere rasoolon ka ittibaa' kar lein. To jawaab milega ke kya tum ne is se pehle qasam nahin khaayi thi ke tumhein kisi tarah ka zawaal na hoga

Aur tum to unhi logon ke makaanaat mein saakin the jinhon ne apne oopar zulm kiya tha, aur tum par waazeh tha ke hum ne un ke saath kya bartaao kiya hai, aur hum ne tumhaare liye misaalein bhi bayaan kar di thin
Aur un logon ne apna saara makr sarf kar diya, aur Khuda ki nigaah mein un ka saara makr hai, agarche un ka makr aisa tha ke us se pahaad bhi apni jagah se hat jaayein
To khabardaar tum yeh khayaal bhi na karna ke Khuda apne rasoolon se kiye hue waade ki khilaaf-warzi karega. Allah sab par ghaalib aur bada intiqaam lene waala hai
Us din jab zameen doosri zameen mein tabdeel ho jaaegi aur aasmaan bhi badal diye jaayenge, aur sab Khuda-e-Waahid o Qahhaar ke saamne pesh honge
Aur tum us din mujrimeen ko dekhoge ke kis tarah zanjeeron mein jakde hue hain
Un ke libaas qatraan ke honge aur un ke chehron ko aag har taraf se dhaanke hue hogi
Taake Khuda har nafs ko us ke kiye ka badla de de, ke woh bahut jald hisaab karne waala hai

Beshak yeh Quran logon ke liye ek paighaam hai taake isi ke zariye inhein daraaya jaaye, aur inhein maaloom ho jaaye ke Khuda hi Khuda-e-Waahid o Yakta hai, aur phir saahibaan-e-aql naseehat haasil kar lein
